rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned hidden true nature
absolutive expressing the prior act leading to the result
compound denoting the concealed essential reality
abstract noun denoting the state of omniscience
verb expressing the emergence of omniscience as a result

items.question: What spiritual attainment arises from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: There exists a hidden true nature to be known.
Knowing that hidden true nature is a decisive cognitive act.
All-knowingness arises as a consequence of that knowledge.
items.inference: Therefore, realization of the hidden true nature results in the emergence of omniscience.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
